runtime.js and renderer.js are from Anime2.5DRig. asuna-rig.js adapts its
mesh deformation, spring simulation and eye masking into a small, on-demand
homepage component. Offline model preparation uses its rigger.js.
No camera, microphone, editor, PSD parser or machine-learning weights are
included in the homepage runtime. Character illustrations belong to their
respective rights holders and are supplied separately by the site owner.

Local performance adaptation (2026-10-11): GPU allocation errors are checked
once per prepared pose instead of synchronously after every texture upload.
